glossary_tank_short: The party member who holds enemy attention and absorbs the damage.
glossary_melee_dps_short: A damage dealer who fights up close.
glossary_rage_short: The warrior's resource: it builds up by fighting and is spent on abilities.
glossary_aggro_short: Enemy attention. The tank wants it; everyone else avoids pulling it.
glossary_taunt_short: A tank ability that forces an enemy to attack you for a short time.
glossary_respec_short: Resetting your talent points to choose a different build (it costs gold).
glossary_specialization_short: The role a class focuses on, like healing or damage.
glossary_legacy_points_short: Points earned while leveling that unlock permanent account-wide perks.
glossary_rested_xp_short: Bonus experience that builds up while you are offline or resting in an inn.
glossary_hearthstone_short: An item that teleports you back to your home inn.
glossary_flight_path_short: Paid routes between flight masters that let you travel across zones.
glossary_need_greed_short: Loot rules: Need for upgrades you will use, Greed for everything else.
glossary_tier2_short: The top raid armor sets of the 1-60 game.
